study: Reinke et al. 2018 — Incredible Years Teacher Classroom Management (IY TCM), group RCT, K-3, WJ-III reading/math, Prevention Science 19:1043-1054
delivery_evidence: IY TCM delivered face-to-face: teachers attended six full-day group training workshops (three sets of two full days) using discussion and video-vignette review, plus embedded in-classroom coaching by a doctoral-level coach who observed and met individually with teachers weekly (Method, p.~1046-1047).
test_alignment_evidence: Achievement outcomes are the Woodcock-Johnson III Broad Reading and Broad Math clusters (age-normed standard scores), administered one-on-one by trained RAs blind to condition — broad independent standardized tests not tailored to the classroom-management PD (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 3, p.1051).
curriculum_evidence: IY TCM is teacher classroom-management/behavior PD aimed at improving teachers' management practices; no new academic curriculum or instructional-materials package is provided; control = wait-list business-as-usual (Method, p.1046-1047).
outcome_timing_evidence: WJ-III reading/math outcomes measured at end of the intervention school year (late April/May; pre = early October of the same year) — immediate post (extraction timepoint=post, end of school year; Table 3).
